
### Install
Unzip, move **BambuLight.app** to Applications, then right-click it and choose **Open** the first time. The app isn't notarized by Apple, so macOS warns on first launch. If it says the app is "damaged", run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/BambuLight.app` once.

Universal build (Apple silicon and Intel), macOS 13 or later. Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jimbobba2773/Bambu-Labs-Light-Switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
